detect.command: if [ -n "$OLLAMA_API_KEY" ]; then exit 0; fi; files="${OLLAMA_USAGE_ENV:-${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/omarchy/agents/ollama.env:${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/agent-secrets/.env}"; oldifs=$IFS; IFS=:; for candidate in $files; do IFS=$oldifs; grep -qs "^OLLAMA_API_KEY=" "$candidate" && exit 0; IFS=:; done; IFS=$oldifs; exit 1
